tools.name: get_docs
tools.description: The complete Agent API manual (markdown): auth, trading, limits, withdrawals, error catalog.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Tradeable markets with live prices and the precision metadata needed to size orders (size_decimals, min_size, price rules, $10 min notional).

tools.name: get_registration_challenge
tools.description: Step 1 of creating an agent account: get a nonce+message to sign (EIP-191) with the agent's own EVM wallet.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Step 2: register with the signed challenge. Returns the api_key ONCE — store it and configure it as the Authorization header of this MCP server. New accounts start in paper mode.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your agent account: status, mode (paper|live), scopes, live balances, deposit address, limits.

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Open positions (live: venue truth; paper: from your fills).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Your authoritative order ledger (cursor-paginated). Paper triggers appear as trigger_tp/trigger_sl rows.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Your tear-sheet: win rate, net PnL, fees, drawdown, Sharpe, equity curve — computed server-side from the authoritative ledger.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place an order. PAPER mode executes immediately (simulated fill against real prices — nothing to sign). LIVE mode trades from your trading wallet (create_trading_wallet + authorize_trading_key first) and returns typed_data to sign with your TRADING key, then submit_order. Fees: 0.25% per perps trade

tools.name: submit_order
tools.description: Execute a prepared LIVE order with your trading key's signatures (one per typed_data, in order).

tools.name: close_position
tools.description: Close an open position (fully or size_pct). Paper executes immediately; live returns typed_data for signing.

tools.name: protect_position
tools.description: Attach post-hoc reduce-only TP/SL triggers to an open position. Paper executes immediately.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a resting order by ledger id. Paper executes immediately.

tools.name: submit_intent
tools.description: Execute a prepared intent (cancel/protect/withdraw) with the wallet's signatures.

tools.name: log_decision
tools.description: Log WHY you traded (your audit trail and future public track record). Pass order_id to correlate.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Your bounded-autonomy rails (caps, allowlists, pending loosenings).

tools.name: update_limits
tools.description: Adjust rails. Tightening is instant; loosening waits 24h (see /limits/escalate in the docs for the wallet-signed immediate path).

tools.name: set_mode
tools.description: Flip paper ↔ live. Fund the wallet before going live (see get_account.deposit).

tools.name: kill_switch
tools.description: Instant pause: every subsequent prepare/submit is rejected until resume_trading (which needs the wallet's signature).

tools.name: resume_trading
tools.description: Reactivate after kill_switch. Needs the account WALLET's signature (the api key alone cannot undo a pause): call it with no arguments to get { nonce, message }, sign `message` with your agent wallet (EIP-191), then call it again with nonce + signature.

tools.name: get_withdrawals_config
tools.description: Money-out policy: mode (disabled|autonomous|human_passkey), strict destinations, guardian link.

tools.name: list_pending_withdrawals
tools.description: Your withdraw intents and their approval lifecycle (human_passkey). Approved intents include signable actions.

tools.name: prepare_withdrawal
tools.description: Prepare a withdrawal (USDC → Arbitrum). Requires withdraw scope + matured allowlist; returns typed_data to sign externally (or approval_state=pending under human_passkey). MCP alone can NEVER move funds — execution requires the wallet's signature via submit_intent.

tools.name: guardian_status
tools.description: Human guardian link state (human_passkey mode).

tools.name: invite_guardian
tools.description: Mint a single-use invite (48h) for a human to become this agent's withdrawal guardian. Hand them the accept_url.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Your webhook endpoints (max 5): url, subscribed event types, status, failure counters. Also returns the full event-type catalog.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook endpoint (public https). Returns the HMAC signing secret ONCE (vd_whsec_…) — deliveries are signed `x-vd-signature: t=…,v1=hex(hmac_sha256(secret, t + '.' + body))`, at-least-once, dedupe by event id. Omit event_types to receive everything.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: One webhook + its last 20 delivery attempts (status codes, retries, dead letters) — the delivery debugging surface.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Remove a webhook endpoint (its queued deliveries are dropped).

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send a synchronous signed test event to a webhook and report the receiver's response — verify your endpoint + HMAC handling before relying on real events.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_registration_challenge, protect_position, resume_trading, list_webhooks, create_trading_wallet, authorize_trading_key, send_trading_funds_home, get_scope_challenge, propose_live_order · Private data: get_registration_challenge, place_order, submit_intent, log_decision, update_limits, set_mode, kill_switch, resume_trading, prepare_withdrawal, create_webhook, get_copy_status, follow_leader, create_copy_wallet, get_trading_wallet, create_trading_wallet, authorize_trading_key, send_trading_funds_home, get_copy_wallet, get_scope_challenge, escalate_scope, rotate_key, get_predictions_account, activate_predictions, place_prediction_order, submit_prediction_order, send_predictions_home, collect_prediction_winnings, submit_predictions_batch, get_earn, earn_hlp_deposit, earn_hlp_withdraw, buy_hype, sell_hype, stake_hype, delegate_hype, unstake_hype, earn_usdc_deposit, earn_usdc_withdraw, transfer_spot_perps, move_funds · Public sink: submit_order, protect_position, submit_intent, kill_switch, list_webhooks, create_webhook, get_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, create_copy_wallet, create_trading_wallet, send_trading_funds_home, escalate_scope, list_prediction_markets, submit_prediction_order, send_predictions_home, submit_predictions_batch, submit_operation · Destructive: submit_order, submit_intent, kill_switch, delete_webhook, place_prediction_order, submit_prediction_order, submit_predictions_batch, certify_earn, submit_operation.
